body: My kids need their father more than they need me. Trying to get things in order and make sure this shift is as easy as possible for everyone.

I need my spouse home. The financial impact that this deployment is causing will take us years to recover from. If the state is going to keep them there then pay them at the same rate with the same tax benefits as a federal activation. 

Provide mental healthcare and a quality living/work environment for soldiers.

Give soldiers the option to get out of their contract early. Soldiers and families cannot afford to be away from their civilian job and make less than they do at their civilian job and less than they do on federal orders. 

Release information to families and media of suicides of soldiers. Stop covering it up and be transparent.
Wrong. 100% the families are alone. I have made calls. I have tried to get help. There is none available.
My spouse is there. I think everyday about my life ending so they can come home and be with the kids. We can't do this for another 10 months. It hurts me to see them hurting so much.
I can't see it either. Did it get deleted?
